# 2 Clement — Chapter 16 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 16
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So then, brothers, since we have received no small opportunity for repentance, while we have time let us turn to God who calls us, while we still have one who receives us.
2. For if we renounce these pleasures and conquer our soul — not following its lusts — we shall share in the mercy of Jesus.
3. But you know that "the day of judgment is coming even now as a burning furnace," and some of the heavens will melt, and the whole earth will be as lead melting on fire, and then will be revealed the hidden and open deeds of men.
4. Almsgiving is therefore good, as repentance from sin. Fasting is better than prayer, but almsgiving is better than both — and love covers a multitude of sins; but prayer out of a good conscience rescues from death.
5. Blessed is every one who is found full of these things; for almsgiving lightens the burden of sin.
